name: vibe-coding-generalist-template
description: Agent ops template and CLI scaffold for AI-assisted software repos.

scripts.check:design: npm run build --workspace @agentops-os/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js design check
scripts.health: npm run build --workspace @agentops-os/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js health
scripts.maintenance: npm run build --workspace @agentops-os/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js maintenance
scripts.maintenance:quick: npm run build --workspace @agentops-os/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js maintenance --no-tests
scripts.maintenance:report: npm run build --workspace @agentops-os/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js maintenance --no-tests --out reports/agent-maintenance.json
